title: Update #2
author: Weak_Wallaby734
selftext:
Sorry for the later then usual post, had an ssd failure. Had to pretty much replace my ssd & have Claude rewrite the whole script. Lost 15k\~ trades of data. So I took the time to withdraw a nice large portion $3500 to be exact, and start it up again.

For my haters who were commenting on the other post saying I’m probably in Dubai partying with models. Nah I’m happily married with a kid, and I work a full time job, can’t spend that much time trying to roast half you negative Nancie’s on here, but here we are 🖕🏼

comments.author: Formally-Fresh
comments.body: I can’t decide which part of this is the lamest

replies.author: Weak_Wallaby734
replies.body: Part where non of you even add to the community, and all you guys do is beg and cry when no one wants to give you their systems?

replies.author: One-Next
replies.body: What are you planning to add?

comments.author: TxEvis
comments.body: What's the name of the app and how does one start with this workflow? I've seen this type of background a lot in this subredit but I don't know what app you're all using. And what wallet does it work with? Is metamask good?

replies.author: tdiggity
replies.body: It's claude. Tell it to "make a dashboard" and you'll get that.

replies.author: Weak_Wallaby734
replies.body: Pretty much told Claude to make me a dashboard, have it hosted on my Tailscale which I can access off my home network

comments.author: tdiggity
comments.body: Looks good, what's holding you back from going BIG?

comments.author: -swanbo
comments.body: So it’s a late make bot, it will get blown eventually

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: losing 15k trades of history to a dead ssd hurts more than the drive. a nightly copy of the trade log to somewhere off that machine is a few lines of script, worth doing before update 3.

replies.author: Weak_Wallaby734
replies.body:
So I had my “server” being a rasp pi with an ssd hat.  
After all this I upgraded to the Mac Mini M6 and bought an additional external SSD. Initial profits paid for it regardless

comments.author: No-Dig-4447
comments.body:
Glad you got it running again :) I also had to deal with an unexpected ssd failure last year and lost all of my data to that….   
A couple of questions about interpreting the dashboard, without asking you to reveal the strategy: does “1,177–0” count distinct settled markets, or individual fills/orders, with multiple entries potentially belonging to the same market?   
And would you be comfortable sharing a rough average entry price?

comments.author: tonyluvbmw
comments.body: How long did it take you to build the bot and get it right
